QuestInfo.name: Faces in the Dark
QuestInfo.0: #b#p603##k in #m10005000# looks pale. Something is wrong with the water.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p603##k says the hot spring under #m10005000# went cold, and now everyone who drinks its water dreams of faces. The spring comes from #m10005076#, full of #r#o37#s#k. I need to defeat #r50 #o37#s#k and bring him #b30 #t4000034#s#k.
QuestInfo.2: I defeated the #r#o37#s#k and gave #b#p603##k their tails. Something drank their warmth. And for one moment, the spring felt warm, like something breathed on it from below.

0.0: Ah, traveler. Please, come closer. I have to tell someone before I lose my nerve.
0.1: All of #m10005000# gets its hot water from a spring deep below. The hotel, #b#p608##k's sauna, the water I soak my herbs in. Three nights ago, the spring went cold.
0.2: Since then, everyone who drinks the water dreams of faces. They look up from the dark and open their mouths, but no sound comes out.
0.3: The spring comes from #m10005076#, and it's full of #r#o37#s#k. Please defeat #r50 #o37#s#k, and bring me #b30 #t4000034#s#k. Their tails are cold the way a hand is cold, not the way ice is cold. I need to know why.

yes.0: Thank you. Go deep into the Ant Tunnel, past #m10005075#. If you see faces in the dark... keep walking. And please, don't keep the tails near your bed.

no.0: I see. I'll stay awake again tonight. I don't want to see them again.

1.0: You're back. Last night, no one dreamed of the faces. ...And you brought the tails. Put them down. Slowly.
1.1: These aren't cold because of ice. They're cold because something drank their warmth. I've felt the same thing in the mushrooms that went bad.
1.2: And last night, for one moment, the spring was warm. Like something breathed on it from below. Here, take this.

mob.0: The faces are still there. Please defeat #r50 #o37#s#k in #m10005076#.

item.0: I still need #b30 #t4000034#s#k from the #r#o37#s#k. I have to see them for myself.
